commonMistakes: Walking so slowly it barely raises the heart rate
Going so hard it becomes a run and can't be sustained
Slouching with the head down at the phone
cues: Brisk enough that talking takes effort, but you still can
Nose breathing if possible — a rough zone 2 gauge
instructions: Warm up with 3-5 minutes of easy walking.
Pick up the pace to brisk: you should feel your heart rate rise and your breathing deepen, but still be able to speak in full sentences.
Maintain that pace for the target duration — 20 to 45 minutes is the sweet spot for a zone 2 session.
Cool down with 3-5 minutes of easy walking. Note your duration; distance and route are secondary.
longevityNotes: If one habit predicted healthy aging, it would be this: regular moderate cardio. Zone 2 work builds the mitochondrial base that powers everything — heart health, metabolic health, brain health — and brisk walking is the most accessible dose. No gym, no gear, no recovery cost. The research is unambiguous: 150+ minutes a week of this transforms risk profiles. It is the highest-return movement in this entire library.
name: Brisk Walk

progression.loadingGuidance: Add 5 minutes per session each week until you reach 45 minutes, then add a second weekly session before increasing intensity.
progression.regressTo: Easy walk, any duration — consistency beats intensity

safetyNotes: If you have a cardiac condition, clear moderate cardio with your clinician first. In heat, carry water and shorten the session; in winter, watch for ice.
